<!-- WARNING: knitr RUNS chunks and inline code even inside an HTML comment
     like this one. To disable a chunk use #| eval: false, never comment it
     out. -->
<!-- One figure = one chunk with a fig-* label, its legend in #| fig-cap and
     #| include: true. Cite it from the text with @fig-richness.
     Quarto assigns the number by ORDER OF APPEARANCE in this section.
     fig-width / fig-height are in INCHES: mm / 25.4 (or use mm(180)).
     Typical journal widths: 1 column 80-90 mm, 2 columns 180 mm. -->

```{r}
#| label: fig-richness
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 6.30
#| fig-cap: "Legend of figure 1. Supports *italics*, **bold** and $equations$."
# Replace this placeholder with your figure.
plot.new(); box(col = "grey80")
text(0.5, 0.5, "figure 1", cex = 2, col = "grey60")
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

```{r}
#| label: fig-abundance
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 3.54
#| fig-cap: "Legend of figure 2."
plot.new(); box(col = "grey80")
text(0.5, 0.5, "figure 2", cex = 2, col = "grey60")
```
